A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DGPO method and ARC evaluation framework. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable and support reliable matching across revisions and relocations.

before.justification: v1 reports original QA benchmark results, ARC evaluations, component ablations, and training-stability experiments in Tables 2–5 and Figures 3, 4, and 6.

after.justification: v3 retains these empirical results and adds model-configuration comparisons in Tables 3, 11, and 12 and a KD→GKD training-stability result in Figure 6.

M1.justification: DGPO retains correct-teacher-output KD initialization followed by token-masked PPO with teacher KL penalties only for incorrect answers. v1 Equations 2–5 match v3 Equations 1–4. The additional model configurations apply the existing procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions train on NQ and HotpotQA and evaluate the same seven QA datasets, with the same NQ/MuSiQue ARC scenarios and Wikipedia retrieval environment. Additional model sizes and families do not introduce new dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: v3 adds KD→GKD to the Figure 6 comparison. The original main comparator identities remain: Skew KLD matches the renamed DistiLLM through the same Ko et al. citation and identical Table 2 scores, although its reported training procedure is revised.

E3.justification: DGPO comparisons expand from Qwen 3B→0.5B to include Qwen 7B→0.5B and Llama 8B→1B, substantially broadening model configurations. Section 5.1 also changes the reported Ko et al. baseline training from exclusively correct TGOs to mixed SGOs/TGOs; unchanged scores do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: v3 adds DGPO sensitivity checks for teacher capacity and model family, plus a KD→GKD control testing whether initialization followed by continued distillation preserves stability. These substantially extend robustness evidence beyond the original DGPO configuration. Existing ARC, component, and stability analyses are retained, with stability material moved to Appendix E.

E5.justification: v1 Appendix A.3 and v3 Appendix B.3 both state that models were trained once. Neither version reports additional seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or comparable uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: All numerical values in the retained main, ARC, and component-ablation tables match. New Tables 3, 11, and 12 report DGPO average EM of 0.323 for Qwen 7B→0.5B and 0.389 for Llama 8B→1B, versus corresponding KD scores of 0.280 and 0.347. Figure 6 additionally reports premature KD→GKD collapse. These are added results under new conditions.

T1.justification: The six numbered equations retain their mathematical content. The general RL objective moves from v1 Section 3.3 to v3 Appendix A, and token masking moves from Appendix A.1 to B.1. No new assumptions, proofs, or substantive derivations are introduced.

C1.justification: The DGPO, ARC, training-stability, and teacher-surpassing claims remain. v3 broadens the highlighted compact-model scope from 0.5B to 0.5–1B and explicitly adds pioneering compact-model agentic-RAG post-training as a problem contribution.

C2.justification: v3 attributes weaker transfer from the larger Qwen teacher to the capacity gap and KD→GKD collapse to excessive teacher constraints. Appendix E reframes the original instability discussion around early convergence and performance plateaus. Model-scope limitations are updated, and the conclusion explicitly identifies QA-only evaluation; existing ARC interpretations largely remain.

D1.justification: v3 Table 8 adds DistiLLM and TAID hyperparameters, while Table 10 documents baseline and ablation components, including the absence of KL regularization in KD→PPO. Core hyperparameters, prompts, and hardware disclosures remain. The code-access footnote and Appendix A.5 link in v1 disappear without replacement; this establishes removal of access information, not withdrawal of the code itself.

R1.justification: v3 adds the Llama 3 reference by Grattafiori et al. and removes Lewis et al. (2020) and Lu et al. (2024). The related-work discussion remains largely intact. Search-R1's updated publication metadata identifies the same work.

P1.justification: The introduction is broadly rewritten and its contribution list reorganized into four categories. RL background and training-stability discussion move into appendices, the separate main-text stability question disappears, and the experimental narrative and appendices are reorganized around model configurations and supporting details.

P2.justification: v3 adds a model-comparison summary, two detailed result tables, and a component matrix. It expands the parameter table, places the ARC tables side by side, relocates training plots to the appendix, adds the KD→GKD curve and legend entry, and adds KD initialization to Figure 1. These substantially revise the visual presentation.

improvement.justification: The additional teacher-size and Llama experiments strengthen evidence beyond v1's single DGPO teacher-student configuration, while the KD→GKD control and component documentation improve experimental interpretation. These gains remain bounded by single-run evaluation on the same QA tasks. Added reproducibility details are partly offset by removal of the code-access pointers, yielding a limited net improvement.
